name: QuantileBinNode
label: Quantile Bin
description: Bins numeric values into equal-frequency quantile buckets based on the sorted values. Each bin contains roughly the same number of values.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table containing the numeric column to bin.

fields.name: NumberOfBins
fields.label: Number Of Bins
fields.description: The number of quantile bins. Defaults to 4 (quartiles).

fields.name: ResultColumnName
fields.label: Result Column Name
fields.description: The name of the bin column. Defaults to '<ValueColumn>_Quantile'.

fields.name: BinnedDataTable
fields.label: Binned Data Table
fields.description: The resulting data table with the quantile bin column.
